subject: Tufts Boston Avenue Dormitory
overview: The Board approved minor exterior modifications for 421-423 High Street and opened public hearings on a 677-bed Tufts University dormitory at 401 Boston Avenue and the proposed Mystic Avenue Corridor District zoning amendment. Both public hearings were continued to December 4, 2024.

items.title: Site Plan Modification: 421-423 High Street
items.summary: Approved modifications to the exterior facade and window layouts for a previously permitted building.

items.title: Site Plan Review: 401 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Tufts University and Capstone Development Partners presented plans to construct a two-building, 10-story, 677-bed dormitory under Dover Amendment review, and the Board continued the hearing to December 4, 2024, after hearing extensive public comment regarding building height, shadow impacts, and construction labor practices.

items.title: Mystic Avenue Corridor District Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Planning consultants and staff presented proposed amendments creating the Mystic Avenue Corridor District with subdistricts, dimensional standards, and incentive zoning provisions, after which the Board voted to continue the hearing to December 4, 2024.
